description: This file manages cursor styles and behaviors for a drawing application, including setting custom cursors for tools like eraser, laser pointer, and selection, and handling theme-based cursor changes.

methods.name: resetCursor
methods.description: Resets the cursor style of the given canvas element.

methods.name: setCursor
methods.description: Sets the cursor style of the given canvas element.

methods.name: setEraserCursor
methods.description: Creates and sets a custom eraser cursor based on the theme.

methods.name: setCursorForShape
methods.description: Sets the cursor style based on the current tool and application state.
